This vignette describes projection of stock biomass under a constant fishing mortality scenario. 

```{r}
runs <- scan(system.file("extdata", "runs_2023", package = "skj"), what = character())
run  <- sample(runs, 1)
```

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)

run_path <- basename(tempfile(pattern = "ss3-"))
dir.create(run_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = run_path)

options(max.print = 10000)
```

```{r libraries}
library(skj)
library(r4ss)
```


```{r}
# copy files from package
copy_ss3_files(run = run, path = ".")

setwd(run)

# read SS files
skj_forecast <- SS_readforecast("forecast.ss", verbose = FALSE)
skj_dat      <- SS_readdat("data.ss", verbose = FALSE)
skj_starter  <- SS_readstarter("starter.ss", verbose = FALSE)

# use F-target
skj_forecast$Forecast     <- 3
skj_forecast$ForeCatch    <- NULL

# report F as harvest rate
skj_starter$F_report_units <- 1
  
# report raw F
skj_starter$F_report_basis <- 0

SS_writeforecast(skj_forecast, dir = ".", overwrite = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
SS_writestarter(skj_starter, dir = ".", overwrite = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

run_ss3()

out <- SS_output(dir = ".", covar = FALSE, printstats = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
FTARGET <- out$derived_quants$Value[out$derived_quants$Label == "annF_Btgt"]
plot_summaryF(out); abline(h = FTARGET, lty = 2)
mtext(paste0("Constant projection at F-target (F = ", round(FTARGET, 2), ")"))
```
